text: Setting clear goals is the foundation of any successful project. A useful method is to create SMART goals, which are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This ensures everyone knows exactly what they are working towards. Once the main goal is set, break it down into smaller milestones. These are key checkpoints that help you track progress and stay motivated. Each milestone should lead to a concrete deliverable, such as a report, a prototype, or a completed section of work. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. Make sure everyone involved, from team members to clients, understands and agrees on the objectives. This prevents confusion and keeps the entire project moving in the same direction.
